title: ChatGPT Images 2.0 Is Actually Crazy
description:
ChatGPT Images 2.0 has officially dethroned Nano Banana!

It’s better at consistent characters, cleaner text inside images, stronger editing, and way more control over the final result.

This is one of the biggest releases this week and I can see why. 

Have you tried it yourself, and what do you think?

And for full reviews of this and all the other AI releases, check out my latest video linked here.

#AI #AInews #chatgptimages #chatgpt #openai
transcript: GPT image 2 is now the top dog. Interestingly, their website announced it fully in images. The whole thing is written up on top of images. My buddy Riley Brown here posted this video on X. He asked it to generate an image of the book Good to Great. The barcode on the book should scan to the actual book. Riley then used a barcode scanner on his phone here to scan the barcode, and look at that, it actually took him to the book Good to Great. Like that was super impressive. Justine Moore here showed this comic book image. I really like the aesthetic. Like the colors look really, really good. Bo Wang here showed an image with a complete cell. I mean, I'm pretty sure that's the nucleus. That looks right to me. Plasma membrane, like this looks like a membrane to me. I'm too dumb to know if this is actually what it's supposed to be, but it looks really impressive. Mark here generated this image of a newspaper with a lot of dense text. And I'm not sure, but the news might be accurate. The amount of dense text that made it onto the image, and it's all coherent and readable. That's what impresses me the most about this.
